lines.en: label soccer20:
scene soccergirls0
I decide to spend yet another morning at the soccer field.
lines.zh: 我决定又在足球场度过一个上午。

lines.en: I feel like I’ve been doing that a lot lately.
lines.zh: 感觉最近这种事做得越来越多了。

lines.en: "It’s a little taxing coming all the way to[school] first thing in the morning, especially on the
lines.zh: "一大早就跑来[school]是有点累人，周末尤其如此，不过托『教书』这份差事的福，

lines.en: weekend, but I’ve managed to somehow get used to it on account of that whole ‘teaching’ thing I do."
lines.zh: 我总算是习惯了。"

lines.en: Combine that with the fact that my trips here are normally pretty exhausting to begin with and it’s surprising that I’m still even showing up.
lines.zh: 再加上我来这儿一趟本来就相当累人，我居然还在坚持露面，这本身就挺让人惊讶的。

lines.en: Who would have thought I’d get so hooked on hanging around a girls’ soccer team?
lines.zh: 谁能想到我居然会这么上瘾，天天泡在一支女子足球队里？

lines.en: Sure, there are the skin tight shorts...the thigh-highs...the toned and developing muscles...
lines.zh: 当然了，有紧身短裤……有过膝长袜……有紧实而仍在发育的肌肉……

lines.en: Actually, it does make sense that I keep coming here when I look at it that way.
lines.zh: 这么一想，我老往这儿跑倒也说得通。

lines.en: scene black
scene soccergirls1
"I spot the three girls I know the names of on a nearby...whatever this
lines.zh: "我在附近那个……管它叫什么的玩意儿上看到了三个我能叫出名字的女生，

lines.en: thing is and come to a full stop several feet away without them noticing."
lines.zh: 于是在几英尺外停住脚步，没被她们发现。"

lines.en: "I wait a moment to find out if they are talking about me (They aren’t) before
lines.zh: 我等了一会儿，想看看她们是不是在聊我（并没有），然后才决定出声，

lines.en: deciding to call out and get myself involved in the conversation..."
lines.zh: 把自己搅进这场对话里……

lines.en: menu:
Hey, Karin
lines.zh: 嘿，Karin

lines.en: $ karin_love += 1
$ hikarin = True
: Hey, Karin. What are you three up to today?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Karin。你们三个今天在忙什么？

lines.en: scene soccergirls2
: Ah-! W-W-What?! Who’s there?!
lines.zh: : 啊——！什、什、什么？！谁在那儿？！

lines.en: : Open your eyes and find out...
lines.zh: : 睁开眼睛看看就知道了……

lines.en: scene soccergirls3
: Oh...Umm...Hey?...
: You kind of surprised me. I didn’t even hear you coming.
lines.zh: : 你吓了我一跳。我压根儿没听见你过来。

lines.en: : Heya, Sensei. Why’d ya call out to Karin? You know she has a heart attack whenever a boy shows up.
lines.zh: : 嗨呀，老师。你怎么对着 Karin 喊？你明知道只要有男生出现她就会心脏病发作。

lines.en: s "That’s precisely why I called out to her instead of you or Kirin. I
lines.zh: s 「这正是我不喊你和 Kirin、偏喊她的原因。我觉得要是 Karin 被吓一大跳之类的，

lines.en: figured it would be funnier if Karin were to get all surprised and whatnot."
lines.zh: 会更有意思。」

lines.en: : And, of course, I was right.
lines.zh: : 当然，我是对的。

lines.en: scene soccergirls4
: Am I...a plaything to you?! You can’t just toy with my condition like that!
lines.zh: : 我对你来说……是个玩具吗？！你不能这么拿我的毛病寻开心！

lines.en: s "It seems a little off to call it a condition, but I’ll try to keep that in mind
lines.zh: s 「管它叫毛病好像有点不太对，不过下次我偷偷靠近你的时候，

lines.en: the next time I sneak up on you."
lines.zh: 我会注意的。」

lines.en: : There will be more times?!
lines.zh: : 还会有下次？！

lines.en: : Of course. I’ll have you warm up to me if it’s the last thing I do.
lines.zh: : 当然。就算这是我这辈子做的最后一件事，我也要让你跟我熟络起来。

lines.en: scene soccergirls5
: Um...well...
: I guess if you're okay with waiting...I-
lines.zh: : 我想如果你愿意等的话……我——

lines.en: : Aaaaaanyway...I’m gonna interrupt this special moment to bring you an important announcement.
lines.zh: : 那那那什么……我要打断这个温馨时刻，来宣布一件重要的事。

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: Hey, Miku
lines.zh: 嘿，Miku

lines.en: $ miku_love += 1
$ himiku = True
: Hey, Miku. What are you guys up to?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Miku。你们在干什么？

lines.en: scene soccergirls6
: Oh, Sensei! We’re just hangin’ around on the giant blue step thingy, talkin’ about life and whatnot.
lines.zh: : 哦，老师！我们就是在这个巨大的蓝色台阶什么的上面待着，聊聊人生啥的。

lines.en: : Why is the soccer team having a discussion about life so early in the morning?
lines.zh: : 足球队一大早为什么要讨论人生？

lines.en: : Shouldn’t you three be practicing for whatever fake-game you have coming up next?
lines.zh: : 你们三个不该为下一场什么假比赛训练吗？

lines.en: scene soccergirls7
: Um...It sounds kinda rude when you call ‘em fake.
lines.zh: : 嗯……管它们叫假比赛，听着有点伤人。

lines.en: : Well, they are, aren’t they? They don’t count for anything.
lines.zh: : 可本来就是假的吧？又不算数。

lines.en: : We tend to use the word unofficial, Sensei...
lines.zh: : 我们一般说「非正式」，老师……

lines.en: scene soccergirls8
: Yeah, what Karin said. And besides, all games have a purpose! Even the fa- Erm, even the unofficial ones!
lines.zh: : 对，Karin 说得对。再说了，所有比赛都有意义！就算是假——呃，就算是非正式的也一样！

lines.en: : If we don’t keep practicin’ we’ll be S-O-L when it comes time to actually play a real team.
lines.zh: : 要是我们不坚持训练，等真要跟一支真正的队伍比赛时，我们就惨了（S-O-L）。

lines.en: : Just of out of curiosity, Miku, do you know what S-O-L stands for?
lines.zh: : 只是好奇问一下，Miku，你知道 S-O-L 是哪几个词吗？

lines.en: scene soccergirls9
: Of course I do~ Hahaha...
lines.zh: : 我当然知道啦~ 哈哈哈……

lines.en: : It stands for-
lines.zh: : 它代表的是——

lines.en: Hey, Kirin
lines.zh: 嘿，Kirin

lines.en: $ kirin_love += 1
$ hikirin = True
: Hey, Kirin. What’s up?
lines.zh: : 嘿，Kirin。怎么样？

lines.en: scene soccergirls10
: Huh? What?
lines.zh: : 咦？什么？

lines.en: : Oh...Uhh, hey.
: I saw you coming but I didn’t really think you were going to call out to {i}me{/i} over those two.
lines.zh: : 我看见你过来了，但真没想到你会先喊{i}我{/i}，而不是她俩。

lines.en: : Yeah, what gives? Did you and Kirin become secret friends behind our backs or somethin’?
lines.zh: : 对啊，什么意思？你和 Kirin 背着我们偷偷成了好朋友还是怎么着？

lines.en: : No. But we do have a sort of contract together now.
lines.zh: : 不是。不过我们现在确实算是有个合约。

lines.en: scene soccergirls11
: Yeaaahhhh...I forgot about that...hahaha...
lines.zh: : 是哦……我把这茬给忘了……哈哈哈……

lines.en: : A contract? What kind of contract?
lines.zh: : 合约？什么合约？

lines.en: : Are you two working on some sort of...new training regimen or something?
lines.zh: : 你们两个是在搞什么……新的训练计划之类的？

lines.en: : Well, that is {i}one{/i} way to put it.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这{i}也{/i}算一种说法吧。

lines.en: scene soccergirls12
: Dude.
lines.zh: : 大哥。

lines.en: : Sorry. Couldn’t help it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。没忍住。

lines.en: : I’m confused. What other sort of contract is there?
lines.zh: : 我糊涂了。那还有什么别的合约？

lines.en: : Yeah, now I’m kinda curious too.
lines.zh: : 对啊，我现在也有点好奇了。

lines.en: scene soccergirls13
: Hey! Uhh, let’s just leave it alone for now, okay? Hahahah~
lines.zh: : 喂！呃，这事咱先别提了好吗？哈哈哈哈~

lines.en: : You’re actin’ kinda weird today...
lines.zh: : 你今天怪怪的……

lines.en: : Shut up. Besides, didn’t you have something you wanted to ask him?
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。再说，你不是有事要问他吗？

lines.en: : Something to ask- Oh!
lines.zh: : 有事要问——哦！

lines.en: scene soccergirls14
: Sensei! I hereby proclaim you the new coach of the soccer team!
lines.zh: : 老师！我在此宣布你成为足球队的新教练！

lines.en: : Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: : What just happened?
lines.zh: : 刚才发生了什么？

lines.en: ka "Miku decided that if you showed up today, she was just
lines.zh: ka 「Miku 决定了，要是你今天出现，她就干脆

lines.en: going to make you the coach instead of waiting for you to agree to it."
lines.zh: 直接让你当教练，不等你点头了。」

lines.en: : Can she do that?
lines.zh: : 她能这么干吗？

lines.en: scene soccergirls15
: There is no limit to my power! Mwahahahaha!
lines.zh: : 我的力量没有极限！哇哈哈哈！

lines.en: : She technically can’t, but are you really gonna say no to that face, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 严格来说她不能，但你真忍心对那张脸说不吗，老师？

lines.en: : What face? The one she has on now?
lines.zh: : 哪张脸？她现在这张？

lines.en: : Tremble before me, mortal!
lines.zh: : 颤抖吧，凡人！

lines.en: : Kirin, are you sure this is the face you’re talking about?
lines.zh: : Kirin，你确定你说的是这张脸？

lines.en: : What’s wrong? I think she’s cute when she turns into a supervillain.
lines.zh: : 怎么了？我觉得她变成超级反派的时候挺可爱的。

lines.en: scene soccergirls16
: Jokin’ aside, I’m puttin’ my foot down, Sensei. You’ve kept me waitin’ for far too long.
lines.zh: : 玩笑归玩笑，这次我可不让步了，老师。你让我等太久了。

lines.en: : We’ve all got achin’ muscles just beggin’ to be massaged by those magic hands of yours!
lines.zh: : 我们全都浑身酸痛，就盼着你那双神奇的手来揉一揉呢！

lines.en: scene soccergirls17
: Wait, what?!
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？！

lines.en: scene soccergirls18
: Yeah! Haven’t you heard? Sensei is apparently a super good moose!
lines.zh: : 对啊！你没听说吗？老师好像是个超厉害的 moose！

lines.en: : Masseuse, Miku. It’s masseuse.
lines.zh: : 是按摩师，Miku。是按摩师。

lines.en: : Also, I’m just okay. I never said I was a god.
lines.zh: : 再说，我只是还行。我从没说过自己是神。

lines.en: : Wait, Miku! I know you said it would be good to have him around, but I’m pretty sure he’s not allowed to like, {i}touch{/i} us...
lines.zh: : 等等，Miku！我知道你说过有他在挺好的，但我很确定他不能那个……{i}碰{/i}我们……

lines.en: : I don’t mind~ My legs have been suuuuuper sore lately. I’m sure some {i}physical{/i} therapy will get all of those knots out in a jiff.
lines.zh: : 我不介意呀~ 我腿最近超——级酸。我敢肯定来点{i}物理{/i}疗法，一下子就能把那些硬块揉开。

lines.en: : Why wouldn’t Sensei be allowed to touch us? The last coach did it all the time and you always talked about how great ya felt after.
lines.zh: : 老师为什么不能碰我们？上一个教练就老这么干，你还老说做完有多舒服呢。

lines.en: scene soccergirls19
: The last coach was a girl, though...She didn’t have any...{i}ulterior motives...{/i}
lines.zh: : 可上一个教练是女生啊……她可没有……{i}别的心思……{/i}

lines.en: : I can hear you, you know...
lines.zh: : 我听得见，你知道吗……

lines.en: : Hmm...
scene soccergirls20
Miku pauses for a moment and stares deep into my soul.
lines.zh: Miku 顿了一下，深深盯着我的灵魂。

lines.en: She doesn’t believe the whole ‘ulterior motives’ thing, does she?
lines.zh: 她该不会真不信「别的心思」那一套吧？

lines.en: Wait a second. I {i}do{/i} have ulterior motives. Why am I getting so up in arms about this accusation?
lines.zh: 等等。我{i}确实{/i}有别的心思。那我干嘛对这种指控这么上火？

lines.en: : *Ahem* Sensei. Or shall I say...Coach!
lines.zh: : *咳咳* 老师。或者该说……教练！

lines.en: : Sensei is fine.
lines.zh: : 叫老师就好。

lines.en: : Coach! Do you have any ulterior motives when it comes to the [young]women of the soccer team?
lines.zh: : 教练！你对足球队的这些[young]女性有什么别的心思吗？

lines.en: scene soccergirls21
: Yeah, Sensei~ You weren’t planning on doing anything {i}naughty{/i} to us, were you?
lines.zh: : 对呀，老师~ 你没打算对我们做什么{i}坏坏的事{/i}吧？

lines.en: Kirin, I’m really going to need you to keep it together right now...
lines.zh: Kirin，我现在真的需要你稳住……

lines.en: : Of course not. I won’t touch anyone how they don’t want to be touched.
lines.zh: : 当然没有。我不会以任何人不想要的方式去碰她们。

lines.en: scene soccergirls22
: Hold on a second...I’m not entirely satisfied with that answer.
lines.zh: : 等一下……我对这个回答不太满意。

lines.en: : What do you mean by how they want to be-
lines.zh: : 「她们想要的方式」是什么意思——

lines.en: : Sounds good to me! You’re the moose here. You know what’ll work best.
lines.zh: : 我觉得挺好！这儿你是 moose。你最清楚怎么弄才有效。

lines.en: scene soccergirls23
: Miku! Don’t I get any sort of say in this? I’m second in command and a year older than you.
lines.zh: : Miku！这事我难道没有发言权吗？我是副队长，还比你大一岁。

lines.en: scene soccergirls24
: You're also a year older than me and I’m still like three times more mature than you~
lines.zh: : 你也比我大一岁，可我还是比你成熟差不多三倍呢~

lines.en: scene soccergirls25
: You still sleep with a teddy bear, Kirin! I don’t want to hear it!
lines.zh: : 你还抱着泰迪熊睡觉呢，Kirin！我不想听这些！

lines.en: : And if you’re more mature than me, how come your curfew is an hour earlier than mine?
lines.zh: : 再说你要是比我成熟，怎么你的门禁还比我早一个小时？

lines.en: scene soccergirls26
: Who cares about a stupid curfew? At least I don’t start crying any time a boy looks at me.
lines.zh: : 谁在意那种蠢门禁？至少我不会一有男生看我就开始哭。

lines.en: : So, Sensei-Coach-Master-
lines.zh: : 那么，老师-教练-主人——

lines.en: : Master has been added on now as well?
lines.zh: : 现在又加上「主人」了？

lines.en: : As you can see, things can get a little dysfunctional around these here parts.
lines.zh: : 你也看到了，我们这一带的情况有时候会有点失控。

lines.en: : So what that means is, as our new coach, you’re gonna have to keep these two in check so they stop frickin’ fightin’ all the time.
lines.zh: : 所以意思就是，作为我们的新教练，你得管住这两个，别让她们整天吵个没完。

lines.en: : Are they really always like this?
lines.zh: : 她们真的一直这样吗？

lines.en: : Well...not {i}all{/i} the time. But yeah, pretty often.
lines.zh: : 嗯……也不是{i}一直{/i}啦。不过确实挺经常的。

lines.en: : I try to step in when I can but it’s not like a pipsqueak who’s just barely outgrown her trainin' bra can really do much to someone Karin’s size.
lines.zh: : 我能劝的时候也会劝，可一个刚脱下训练胸衣的小不点，对上 Karin 那个头也没什么办法。

lines.en: : And Kirin’s kinda scary in her own way too. Like one of those feisty types that’ll pull ‘yer hair if ya mess with her.
lines.zh: : 而且 Kirin 也有她自己吓人的地方。就那种暴脾气类型，你要是惹她，她会揪你头发。

lines.en: Yeah, I definitely get that vibe from Kirin as well.
lines.zh: 是啊，我从 Kirin 身上也确实感觉到这股气场。

lines.en: : And you’re really sure about me being the coach? I think I’ve told you before, but I really can’t be here every day.
lines.zh: : 你们真确定要我当教练吗？我记得之前说过，我真的没法每天都来。

lines.en: scene soccergirls27
: That’s totally fine! We can always do stuff later on if ya can’t make it to the field.
lines.zh: : 完全没问题！你要是来不了球场，我们随时可以换个时间再搞。

lines.en: scene soccergirls26
: None of us really have anythin’ to do besides soccer and trainin’ and whatnot anyway.
lines.zh: : 反正我们除了足球和训练什么的也没别的事干。

lines.en: mi "So if ya ever want to just do laps around the park or somethin’ like that, you can always let
lines.zh: mi 「所以你要是哪天想绕着公园跑几圈啥的，随时

lines.en: your good pal Miku know."
lines.zh: 找你的好哥们 Miku 就行。」

lines.en: scene soccergirls28
: Oh, actually! I’ve got an even better idea!
lines.zh: : 哦，对了！我还有个更好的主意！

lines.en: : How about you take down our phone numbers?!
lines.zh: : 你把我们的电话号码存下来怎么样？！

lines.en: scene soccergirls29
: I second that! Take mine first, Sensei!
lines.zh: : 我附议！先存我的，老师！

lines.en: scene soccergirls30
Kirin pulls a smartphone out from the inside of her shirt and types out her contact info on it before holding it up for me to see.
lines.zh: Kirin 从衣服里掏出智能手机，把自己的联系方式输了进去，然后举起来给我看。

lines.en: I type the numbers down in my phone and click ‘save,’ still awaiting the next two numbers.
lines.zh: 我把号码输进手机，点下「保存」，等着剩下两个号码。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You now have Kirin’s cell phone number!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你获得了 Kirin 的手机号码！{/i}

lines.en: : I can’t remember...do ya already have my number, Sensei?
lines.zh: : 我记不清了……老师你已经有我号码了吗？

lines.en: mi "We’ve been together a lot and I’m kinda forgetful, so sorry if ya
lines.zh: mi 「我们老待在一起，我又有点健忘，要是你早就有了

lines.en: already have it and I’m bein’ weird. Hahahaha~"
lines.zh: 我还这么问，那可太怪了，抱歉哈。哈哈哈哈~」

lines.en: : Nope, don’t think so. Here, you can type it in yourself.
lines.zh: : 没有，应该没有。给你，你自己输吧。

lines.en: : Coolio!
lines.zh: : 酷毙了！

lines.en: scene soccergirls31
Miku runs over and rapidly types her number into my phone.
lines.zh: Miku 跑过来，飞快地在我手机里敲下她的号码。

lines.en: "I’m surprised she’s able to do it so quickly. I know she’s full of energy but I
lines.zh: "她居然能敲得这么快，我挺意外的。我知道她精力旺盛，但我原以为

lines.en: kind of figured that would all be saved for the field, not technology."
lines.zh: 那股劲头会全留到球场上，而不是用在电子设备上。"

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You now have Miku’s cell phone number as well!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你也获得了 Miku 的手机号码！{/i}

lines.en: : Kirin and I are gonna go ahead!
lines.zh: : 我和 Kirin 先走一步啦！

lines.en: : Good luck tryin’ to get Karin’s number, Sensei! She’s never given it to a boy before!
lines.zh: : 老师，祝你顺利拿到 Karin 的号码！她还从没把号码给过男生呢！

lines.en: "Miku and Kirin start jogging toward where all of the other
lines.zh: "Miku 和 Kirin 朝其他女生

lines.en: girls are playing and I’m suddenly left alone with Karin..."
lines.zh: 玩闹的地方慢跑过去，我突然就只剩下和 Karin 两个人了……"

lines.en: scene soccergirls32
: Mmh...
: Umm...I-
: You don’t have to give me your number if you don’t want to, Karin.
lines.zh: : 你不想的话不用给我号码，Karin。

lines.en: scene soccergirls33
: Huh?
: I don’t blame you for feeling weird around guys. Especially older ones like me.
lines.zh: : 你在男生身边觉得不自在，这我不怪你。尤其是像我这样年纪大的。

lines.en: : If anything, I think that most of the other girls are surprisingly forward.
lines.zh: : 要说的话，我反觉得其他那些女生开放得惊人。

lines.en: : Um-
s "Besides, even if you don’t want me to be your coach, I’ll do what I can to
lines.zh: s 「再说，就算你不想要我当你的教练，我也会尽我所能，

lines.en: make sure it doesn’t bother you or anything like that."
lines.zh: 尽量不让这事给你添麻烦之类的。」

lines.en: : Uhh-
: I know you’ve been on the team for a while and I obviously wouldn’t want to be stepping on your toes, but-
lines.zh: : 我知道你在队里待了挺久了，我当然也不想越俎代庖，不过——

lines.en: scene soccergirls34
: T-T-T-Take my number too!
lines.zh: : 也、也、也把我的号码存上吧！

lines.en: scene soccergirls35
: Mmmnnn...
lines.zh: : 嗯嗯嗯……

lines.en: : Are you sure?
lines.zh: : 你确定？

lines.en: Karin quickly nods her head up and down in place of responding.
lines.zh: Karin 用力上下点着头，代替了回答。

lines.en: I hand her my cell and, with trembling fingers, she types her phone number in.
lines.zh: 我把手机递给她，她用颤抖的手指输入了自己的号码。

lines.en: Sure, she needs to backspace some of the digits a few times, but she gets it done in the end.
lines.zh: 她确实得退格删掉好几个数字重来几次，不过最后还是输完了。

lines.en: {i}Congratulations! You now have Karin’s cell phone number too!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}恭喜！你也获得了 Karin 的手机号码！{/i}

lines.en: {i}Wow! Three phone numbers in one day! It’s almost like you’re the protagonist of a porn game!{/i}
lines.zh: {i}哇！一天拿到三个电话号码！简直像色情游戏的主角一样！{/i}

lines.en: scene soccergirls34
: Okay bye!
lines.zh: : 好了拜拜！

lines.en: scene soccergirls36
"With borderline-frightening speed, Karin joins the rest of her teammates and
lines.zh: "Karin 以近乎吓人的速度追上其他队友，

lines.en: absolutely demolishes them in terms of speed as they make their way around the track."
lines.zh: 在绕跑道这件事上把她们彻底碾压了。"

lines.en: Somehow, I don’t even think Miku would be able to keep up with her right now...
lines.zh: 不知怎么的，我都觉得这会儿 Miku 未必追得上她……
